scope.core_modules_in_scope_rationale: account_coordination/account_io/account_metadata match the account_* naming convention directly. auth/oauth_login/oauth_refresh do not carry the account_ prefix but are the account-identity/credential model (AuthFile/AuthTokens/AuthSnapshot) and the OAuth login/refresh flows that commands/account_oauth wraps -- excluding them would leave commands/account_oauth's backend owner unaccounted for. This mirrors the grouping the pre-existing raw evidence itself uses (backend-baseline/account-auth-baseline.md calls this cluster 'account-auth').
scope.core_modules_excluded_rationale: The pre-existing account-auth-baseline.md groups these three into the same 120-function document alongside the six in-scope modules, but bootstrap_cache is a generic app-launch cache (not account-identity-specific), and sessions/session_analytics manage Codex CLI rollout/conversation history, not account switching/credential lifecycle -- a materially different domain. Excluded from this package's primary coverage; cross-referenced via pointers only.
